messages:
sasha: Quick check — we need a short-lived +10 A100 slot for a canary tomorrow 09:00 PST. Anyone see spare capacity in us-west2?
ben: +1 on quick check. which pool? demo or reserved?
maya: demo pool is pretty tapped, reserved has 2 free but behind a billing CR.
ramon: I can free up one slot from an underused experiment (ends tonight). Need a CR bump to move billing tag.
evan: what's the CR number? I can tag it if you drop the PR.
sasha: thanks. CR: #4821 — move tenant:canary -> tenant:demo-temp. small change in terraform:
```hcl
resource "redwood_gpu_reservation" "canary-temp" {
  count = 1
  sku   = "a100-40gb"
  region = "us-west2"
  label  = "demo-temp-canary"
}
```
ramon: pinged @procure-bot to check vendor slots; also submitted PR for CR-4821.
procure-bot: VendorStatus: vendor-alpha has 6 A100s free in us-west2; estimated allocation time 45m for reservation requests.
evan: if vendor can allocate in 45m we'll be green to schedule; canary needs 1.5h smoke window though.
ben: cost note — temporary reservation will bill at burst rates ~1.8x. FYI for budget.
sasha: ok — proceed with vendor allocation if PR merges. @maya can you merge once tests pass?
maya: on it. tests failing flakily on one infra test, rerunning now :eyes:
oncall-bot: Reminder: maintenance window us-west2 tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC. If allocation crosses that, expect brief interruptions.
ramon: thanks. I'll aim to have reservation request in 30m after PR merged.
evan: i'll reserve the canary timeslot in calendar (09:00 PST).
sasha: perfect. if vendor delays >1h we'll fall back to borrowing from reserved pool — ramon please flag. :thumbsup:
ben: noted. posting a short follow-up in #product so they see the cost hit.
sasha: thread summary: PR #4821 -> merge -> vendor allocation request to vendor-alpha -> reserve +1 A100 us-west2 -> canary 09:00 PST. anyone object?
ben: none from infra side.
maya: merged, allocation request queued.
procure-bot: AllocationRequest: queued with vendor-alpha, ETA ~40m.
sasha: thanks all — will update if anything shifts.
